description: This file defines API endpoints for timing-related operations within a FastAPI application. It includes request/response models, route definitions, and dependency injection for the TimingService.

classes.name: TWTTResponse
classes.description: Response model for TWTT computation containing TWTTData.

classes.name: ETWTTResponse
classes.description: Response model for eTWTT aggregation containing average RMS error and segment count.

methods.name: TWTTResponse compute_twtt_api(req: TWTTRequest, svc: TimingService = Depends(get_timing_service))
methods.description: API endpoint to compute TWTT from timestamps, returns a TWTTResponse.

methods.name: ETWTTResponse compute_etwtt_api(req: ETWTTRequest, svc: TimingService = Depends(get_timing_service))
methods.description: API endpoint to aggregate eTWTT segments, returns an ETWTTResponse.

ctags.name: compute_etwtt_api
ctags.pattern: /^def compute_etwtt_api(req: ETWTTRequest, svc: TimingService = Depends(get_timing_service)) -> ET/

ctags.name: compute_twtt_api
ctags.pattern: /^def compute_twtt_api(req: TWTTRequest, svc: TimingService = Depends(get_timing_service)) -> TWTT/
